metadata.description: Curated sources for practical data science workflows: framing, EDA, validation, tabular modeling, evaluation, uncertainty, reproducibility, DS-to-MLOps handoff, and LLM data pipelines.
metadata.title: AI Ml Data Science - Sources

foundational_papers_and_books.name: The Elements of Statistical Learning
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Core reference for statistical learning concepts and evaluation foundations.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: An Introduction to Statistical Learning
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Practical ML and statistics reference for model selection, validation, and interpretation.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Datasheets for Datasets
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Dataset documentation framework for governance, provenance, and risk assessment.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Model Cards for Model Reporting
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Standardized reporting template for model performance, intended use, and limitations.

foundational_papers_and_books.name: Hidden Technical Debt in Machine Learning Systems
foundational_papers_and_books.relevance: Classic reference on production ML failure modes and maintenance costs.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: uv Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Modern Python project, dependency, and script management for reproducible DS workflows.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: marimo Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Git-friendly, reactive notebooks for exploratory analysis and reviewable DS workflows.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: pandas Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Core tabular data manipulation and analysis reference.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: Polars Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: High-performance dataframe engine with lazy execution for scalable transforms.

python_workflow_and_compute.name: DuckDB Python Documentation
python_workflow_and_compute.relevance: Embedded analytical SQL engine for local reproducible DS analysis.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: scikit-learn Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Core preprocessing, model selection, metrics, threshold tuning, and calibration utilities. Verified current stable release is 1.9.0 (2026-06-02); check installed version before citing API specifics.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: LightGBM Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Strong tabular baseline for fast iteration and structured-data experiments.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: CatBoost Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Gradient boosting with strong categorical support and competitive tabular performance.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: PyTorch Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Deep learning framework reference when neural approaches are justified.

core_ml_and_evaluation.name: MAPIE Documentation
core_ml_and_evaluation.relevance: Prediction intervals and conformal prediction utilities for uncertainty-aware model outputs.

data_quality_and_validation.name: Pandera Documentation
data_quality_and_validation.relevance: Schema and dataframe validation for DS pipelines and feature contracts.

data_quality_and_validation.name: Great Expectations Core Documentation
data_quality_and_validation.relevance: Expectation-based validation workflows for dataset and pipeline checks.

data_quality_and_validation.name: Evidently Documentation
data_quality_and_validation.relevance: Data quality, drift, and monitoring metrics used in DS handoff and validation reviews.

experimentation_and_automation.name: karpathy/autoresearch
experimentation_and_automation.relevance: Autonomous ML experiment agent: bounded modification surface, fixed eval metric (val_bpb), git-as-experiment-ledger, 5-min time budget per run. Reference for Pattern 8.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: MLflow Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage for reproducible DS work.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: Weights & Biases Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Experiment tracking, comparisons, artifact lineage, and collaborative reviews.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: DVC Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Data and pipeline version tracking for reproducible experiments.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: lakeFS Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Git-like versioning for data lakes and branchable data experiments.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: Feast Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: Feature-store reference for train/serve parity and reusable feature definitions.

reproducibility_and_handoff.name: SQLMesh Documentation
reproducibility_and_handoff.relevance: SQL transformation patterns for staging, intermediate, and marts layers with testing.

llm_data_pipelines.name: TabPFN-2.5 (arXiv 2511.08667)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: TabPFN-2.5 extends the TabPFN family to 50k rows and 2k features. Confirmed resolving as of 2026-05-17. Win-rate figures are model-version-specific; hedge before asserting.

llm_data_pipelines.name: text-dedup (MinHash/LSH deduplication library)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Production-grade MinHash LSH and exact dedup for large text corpora. Used in LLM data pipeline reference.

llm_data_pipelines.name: Min-K% Prob — Contamination Detection (arXiv 2310.16789)
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Post-training benchmark contamination detection via minimum-k% token log-probability. Cited in evaluation-patterns.md §10 and llm-data-pipeline.md §4.

llm_data_pipelines.name: Cleanlab Documentation
llm_data_pipelines.relevance: Confident learning and label noise detection for supervised ML datasets. Referenced in data-contracts-lineage.md §7 annotation-quality section.

governance_and_security.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework 1.0
governance_and_security.relevance: Governance baseline for AI risk management, documentation, accountability, and controls.

governance_and_security.name: EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
governance_and_security.relevance: Regulatory baseline affecting documentation, monitoring, and high-risk model governance.

governance_and_security.name: NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
governance_and_security.relevance: Secure development practices relevant for DS pipelines and service handoff.

governance_and_security.name: NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile
governance_and_security.relevance: Useful governance reference when DS work overlaps with GenAI systems or agentic evaluation.
